material_findings.finding: The judgment says the AI narrative is evidenced only by guidance and lacks sourced quarter-discrete AI revenue. Its selected reviewed evidence EV::734A9C177164E08E explicitly states that Dell recognized USD 16.1 billion of AI server revenue in the quarter and booked USD 24.4 billion of AI orders.
material_findings.business_impact: The report understates the demonstrated conversion from orders to current-quarter revenue and misclassifies an actual disclosed result as a gap.

material_findings.finding: The judgment says the issuer disclosure did not separately provide AI orders, backlog or segment profit. The same cell selected EV::734A9C177164E08E, which explicitly provides AI orders and recognized AI server revenue. The case pack additionally contains EV::9006E2D4E0F61CCF with record AI backlog of USD 51.3 billion. Segment profit remains genuinely absent, but orders and backlog do not.
material_findings.business_impact: A legitimate product-profit gap is bundled with two facts that are present, turning a bounded limitation into a false factual statement.

material_findings.finding: The synthesis promotes the counterevidence cell's false absence claim into a cross-cell conflict, stating that AI orders and backlog were not separately disclosed and therefore conflict with the demand cell. The reviewed case evidence directly discloses both.
material_findings.business_impact: The final report invents a conflict instead of adjudicating the real issue: disclosed order and backlog strength versus uncertain cancellation, pull-forward, durability and product-level profit conversion.

cell_assessments.assessment: Correctly distinguishes observed AI orders, recognized revenue, backlog and customer count from end consumption and durability; preserves pull-forward, cancellation and shipment-timing alternatives.
Company-level revenue, profit and cash boundaries are conservative, but the cell incorrectly denies current-quarter AI revenue that appears in its own selected evidence.

The repaired judgment correctly limits itself to company-level same-basis revenue, gross profit, operating income and margin observations and refuses product-level profit attribution. The historical mix-pressure counterread should state its FY2026 Q3 period more clearly in the rendered narrative.

Correctly identifies company-level OCF and FCF improvement and refuses AI cash attribution. Accounts payable is imprecisely described as working-capital use rather than supplier financing, and financing-receivable interpretation remains only bounded inference.

It correctly seeks independent pressure and preserves the product-profit bridge gap, but falsely says AI orders are not disclosed and gives low-value unnormalized cross-company absolute inventory context too much attention.

eight_dimension_quality.formal_score_reason: The frozen rubric forbids formal Q1-Q8 acceptance scoring when L1 or L2 fails.

dimensions.reason: The report is strongly Dell-specific and directly addresses demand durability, profit and cash conversion.
Evidence bindings are visible, but two judgments contradict selected reviewed evidence and the synthesis compounds the error.
Company revenue, margin, profit and cash relations are interpreted with correct scope; product-level bridge gaps remain explicit.
The order-to-revenue, supply constraint, pull-forward and cash mechanisms are bounded and alternatives are retained.
The report integrates cells, but its material named conflict is factually false and therefore cannot support a decision.
The AI-to-profit/cash bridge gap and pull-forward risk are substantive, though the counterevidence cell bundles real gaps with facts already disclosed.
Routes and time horizon exist, but positive bridge validation and negative reversal triggers are mixed under one reverse direction and no numeric threshold is bound.
The report is readable and materially better than a template, but requires correction of a central evidence contradiction before senior use.

root_cause_disposition.model_failure: DeepSeek contradicted source-visible facts in its own selected evidence and then repeated the false premise across cells.
root_cause_disposition.project_failure: The contract validates positive refs and typed gaps but has no typed distinction between not_visible_in_this_cell and absent_from_the_case_pack. Synthesis receives validated cell prose and refs without a compact case-level reviewed-fact presence index, so a local negative assertion can be promoted as global truth.
required_structural_fix: Compile a provider-neutral case-level reviewed fact presence catalog from current Evidence, NumericFact and typed relations.
Represent cell-local visibility separately from case-level absence; only the Harness may authorize a case-level absence after checking the current catalog and typed gaps.
Give synthesis a compact fact-coverage and gap matrix and reject a conflict whose stated premise contradicts the case catalog.
Use zero-call DELL, MU, NVDA and holdout mutations before any new live; do not add phrase-specific prompt patches or rerun unaffected nodes.

known_boundary: R7 proves that the stable runtime can produce five contract-valid judgments and a complete report with three successor calls. It does not prove financial truth, content acceptance, heterogeneous generalization, qualified-human acceptance, S3 completion, Workbench publication or release readiness.
